# RuvNet Brain 5.0.0-skeleton.1: reference

## Commands

As printed by the command itself (`ruvnet-brain` with no arguments, then each added command with `--help`).

```
usage:
  ruvnet-brain install --from <release folder or https address> [--plan] [--repair] [--register-hosts]
  ruvnet-brain update [--from <release folder or https address>] [--plan] [--register-hosts]
  ruvnet-brain doctor
  ruvnet-brain status
  ruvnet-brain clean
  ruvnet-brain uninstall [--purge-private]
  ruvnet-brain config auto-update on|off
  ruvnet-brain config update-url <https address>|none
  ruvnet-brain config show
usage:
  ruvnet-brain migrate [--plan] --from <release folder or https address>       print what would happen; changes nothing
  ruvnet-brain migrate --apply --from <release folder or https address> [--register-hosts]
  ruvnet-brain rollback-to-4            the brake: switch version 5 off and hand back to 4.7 (checks 4.7 can serve)
  ruvnet-brain rollback-to-4 --undo     release the brake: version 5 back on
usage:
  ruvnet-brain guard on        before a file that names a rUv product is written, ask for a search first
                               (advisory only while search is not ok; an in-file line lets a write through)
  ruvnet-brain guard off       the default
  ruvnet-brain guard status
```

## Health states and their fixes

Every state the one verdict can produce, from `packages/health/assess.mjs` (`FIX`, `assess`) and `packages/health/line.mjs` (`renderLine`); the live line also shows "since <time>".

| Cause | State | Fix | Line the AI sees |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ok | OK | `(none)` | `[RuvNet Brain OK · knowledge of 16 Nov · search_ruvnet ready]` |
| not-installed | NOT INSTALLED | `ruvnet-brain install` | `[RuvNet Brain NOT INSTALLED · RuvNet Brain 5 is not installed · fix: ruvnet-brain install]` |
| not-running | NOT RUNNING | `run 'node -v'; then restart the session` | `[RuvNet Brain NOT RUNNING · the search server did not start in this session · fix: run 'node -v'; then restart the session]` |
| heartbeat | UNKNOWN | `restart the session` | `[RuvNet Brain UNKNOWN · the search server stopped reporting (stale heartbeat) · fix: restart the session]` |
| pending | UNKNOWN | `wait one minute` | `[RuvNet Brain UNKNOWN · the self-test has not finished yet · fix: wait one minute]` |
| probe-failed | DOWN | `ruvnet-brain install --repair` | `[RuvNet Brain DOWN · pack failed its self-test (a probe did not find its file) · fix: ruvnet-brain install --repair]` |
| no-probes | UNKNOWN | `ruvnet-brain install --repair` | `[RuvNet Brain UNKNOWN · the self-test ran no probes · fix: ruvnet-brain install --repair]` |
| incomplete | UNKNOWN | `restart the session` | `[RuvNet Brain UNKNOWN · the self-test record is incomplete (no valid time, or a result that did not pass) · fix: restart the session]` |
| overdue | UNKNOWN | `restart the session` | `[RuvNet Brain UNKNOWN · the self-test has not run for 2 h · fix: restart the session]` |
| generation | UNKNOWN | `restart the session` | `[RuvNet Brain UNKNOWN · the server is on app 5.0.0 pack g1, neither the installed app 5.0.1 nor the one kept before it · fix: restart the session]` |
| lane | DEGRADED | `ruvnet-brain install --repair` | `[RuvNet Brain DEGRADED · lane history unavailable · fix: ruvnet-brain install --repair]` |
| safe-mode | DEGRADED | `restart the session` | `[RuvNet Brain DEGRADED · last search used keyword-only safe mode (the deadline passed) · fix: restart the session]` |
| rolled-back | DEGRADED | `ruvnet-brain doctor` | `[RuvNet Brain DEGRADED · update to 5.0.2 failed its check after the switch and was rolled back · fix: ruvnet-brain doctor]` |
| host-unserved | DEGRADED | `ruvnet-brain doctor` | `[RuvNet Brain DEGRADED · Codex not served by version 5 (a [mcp_servers.ruvnet-brain-5] table outside the managed block) · fix: ruvnet-brain doctor]` |

## What runs, what is written, what is sent

From `packages/plugin/claude` (the host entries; an installed copy names the launcher under the brain home in place of `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}`), `packages/contract` (defaults and the home layout), `packages/cli/hosts.mjs`, `packages/migrate` and `packages/guard`.

| What runs | When | Detail |
| --- | --- | --- |
| host hook (UserPromptSubmit) | every prompt | `"${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/rb5" hook \|\| echo "[RuvNet Brain] DOWN: Node could not run. Search is unavailable. Fix: run 'node -v' in a terminal; reinstall Node if it fails."`, timeout 5 s |
| host hook (PreToolUse) | before each Write, Edit, MultiEdit, NotebookEdit (Claude Code only); does nothing while the guard is off | `"${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/rb5" guard`, timeout 10 s |
| search server "ruvnet-brain-5" | one per session, started by the host | `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/rb5 server` |
| heartbeat, inside the search server | every 1 min | no scheduled job, cron entry or Windows task |
| self-test (probes), inside the search server | every 30 min | no scheduled job, cron entry or Windows task |
| update check, inside the search server | every 240 min | no scheduled job, cron entry or Windows task |

| What is written | Where |
| --- | --- |
| current | `<brain home>/current.json` |
| app | `<brain home>/app` |
| packs | `<brain home>/packs` |
| private | `<brain home>/private` |
| state | `<brain home>/state` |
| status | `<brain home>/state/status` |
| config | `<brain home>/state/config.json` |
| update | `<brain home>/state/update.json` |
| updateCheck | `<brain home>/state/update-check.json` |
| host shim | `<brain home>/shim/**` |
| migrate and rollback-to-4: migration | `<brain home>/state/migration.json` (nothing of 4.7 is written) |
| migrate and rollback-to-4: brake | `<brain home>/state/brake.json` (nothing of 4.7 is written) |
| migrate and rollback-to-4: config | `<brain home>/state/config.json` (nothing of 4.7 is written) |
| write guard override record (only when an override line is used) | `<brain home>/state/guard-overrides.jsonl` |
| host settings | only with `--register-hosts`: one prompt hook and one search server ("ruvnet-brain-5") per host, plus the write guard's tool-use hook in Claude Code; recorded in state/hosts.json and removed by uninstall |
| pre-registration copies of the host files | `<brain home>/state/host-backup` (mode 0600; uninstall puts each file back byte for byte while it is still what registration wrote) |

| What is sent | Default | Detail |
| --- | --- | --- |
| automatic update check | on | no request until an update address is set (install from a web address, or ruvnet-brain config update-url) |
| owner page | off | a POST to the topic in state/config.json pageTopic, only when one is set |
| questions, answers, telemetry | none | nothing else leaves the machine |

Optional write guard: off by default (`ruvnet-brain guard on` turns it on).
